response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT t.transreg, tr.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord t ON ab.translink = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), grouped AS (SELECT transreg, tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM linked GROUP BY transreg, tradekind), shares AS (SELECT transreg, tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM grouped) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares GROUP BY tradekind
